brief.headline: Close the ₹8.48 L/yr gap to our best price and qualify a second source — their finances aren't public, so lean on our data and strong alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Match the best price we already pay for the same items
priceAsk.target: ₹7.62/NOS for PET BOT AMBER 250ML (currently ₹8.49/NOS) and ₹5.24/NOS for PET BOT AMBER BRUT 250ML (currently ₹5.38/NOS) — close the ₹8.48 L/yr gap
priceAsk.basis: We pay TPAC Packaging ₹7.62/NOS and Suraj Blow Plast ₹5.24/NOS for the same bottles. PIK's 11.5% premium on the first SKU alone costs us ₹7.19 L/yr extra. Market research shows 28 mm caps at ₹0.85–0.95/pc are MARKET-FAIR with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at volume — so matching our internal best is reasonable.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to change

brief.financialLeverage: PIK Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.92 Cr spend is real money, but without knowing their size we can't gauge how important we are to them. The smart play is to use our own data — we already buy these bottles cheaper elsewhere — and to quietly line up Manjushree Technopack (₹2569.83 Cr, health B) or Mold-Tek Packaging (₹1010.97 Cr, health B) as a second source. That backup gives us room to press for the best price we pay without worrying about losing supply.

evidence.point: We pay ₹8.48 L/yr more to PIK than the cheapest price we already get for the same items
PIK charges ₹8.49/NOS for PET BOT AMBER 250ML; TPAC Packaging sells it to us at ₹7.62/NOS — an 11.5% gap
That one SKU alone costs us ₹7.19 L/yr extra
Market research finds 28 mm caps at ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume — verdict MARKET-FAIR
PIK's second SKU (PET BOT AMBER BRUT 250ML) is ₹5.38/NOS; Suraj Blow Plast does ₹5.24/NOS — a 2.6% gap worth ₹1.29 L/yr

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B) — makes pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate and already flagged for packaging.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B) — pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (backup lead: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries)
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — manufacturer in India-East; medium confidence as a maker of rigid packaging materials.

risks: PIK's financials aren't public, so we can't see early-warning signs of trouble — monitor delivery performance closely and accelerate the second-source qualification.
If we push hard on price without a qualified backup in place, PIK could walk and leave us scrambling — line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek first.
The ₹8.48 L saving assumes PIK will match our best internal price across all items — they may resist on some SKUs, so prioritize the big one (PET BOT AMBER 250ML at ₹7.19 L/yr excess).
Market backups like IVL Dhunseri and Chemco are leads, not qualified sources — don't treat them as ready alternates until we've verified capability and pricing.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to align your pricing with the best rates we already pay — starting with the PET bottles, where we're spending ₹8.48 lakhs a year more than we need to.
